correctness.rationale: An explicit orbit-barycenter PL model for graph-independence fixed points and exact enumeration of symmetry orbits give the four subgroup graph models for every n. The even half-chain graph folds off the terminal-rung vertex, leaving an isolated vertex and hence a cone. The odd combined-reflection triangle-apex has that collapsible even half-chain as link, so its independence complex collapses onto the original odd half-chain. Chandrakar–Singh Theorem 3.1 supplies the latter ordinary homotopy, with the n=1 three-point exception proved directly. Direct package-path verifier execution passed 48 orbit model checks and 28 mod-two homology comparisons (n=1..7 and all four subgroups); finite checks are additional evidence only. Boundaries n>=1, n even/odd and subgroup definitions were explicitly reconstructed.

value.rationale: Geometric subgroup fixed-point homotopy types are natural equivariant-topological invariants of the same family for which the complete homology character was previously studied. The result simultaneously classifies every subgroup of the geometric Klein-four action, with a uniform parity exchange between two involutions: one retains two spheres of half the ambient dimension while the other collapses; row-swap and whole-group loci are explicit PL balls. The PL orbit models and relative collapses provide structural information unavailable from ordinary homology ranks or homology characters. The contribution is not merely a finite recalculation or a new description of a known Euler trace.
